info.title: Autumn Task API
info.description: Durable research tasks run by a sandboxed agent. Auth on every request: `X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. JSON over HTTP; `/stream` routes are server-sent events. Errors share one body: branch on `error`, retry when `retryable` is true.

get.description: One page of tasks, pinned first then most recently updated. Default 50 per page, at most 200. When more remain, the response carries an `X-Next-Cursor` header and a `Link: <...>; rel="next"` header; pass that value as `cursor` to fetch the next page. No header means this is the last page.

examples: Add founder LinkedIn URLs for all existing rows, then continue until there are 25 rows.

wait.description: Wait for the turn to finish (200). Default false: queue and return (202).

task_id.description: Continue this task instead of creating one.

name.description: Display name. Derived from the prompt when omitted. Applies only when the task is created; ignored on an existing task_id.

clarify.title: Clarify
clarify.description: Allow one blocking planning question before work starts. Default false: plan and execute without asking.

output.title: Output
output.description: The output artifact to collect: id, kind, path, name; for research also schema, schema_order, target_count. Applies only when the task is created; ignored on an existing task_id.

input_schema.title: Input Schema
input_schema.description: Column types of input_rows. Applies only when the task is created; ignored on an existing task_id.

input_rows.title: Input Rows
input_rows.description: Rows to enrich, one object per row. Applies only when the task is created; ignored on an existing task_id.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Each value is a rule in plain language; the key names it. Applies only when the task is created; ignored on an existing task_id.

examples.us_only: Only include companies headquartered in the United States.

count.title: Count
count.description: Target row count. Applies only when the task is created; ignored on an existing task_id.

target_count.title: Target Count
target_count.description: Alternative to count. Applies only when the task is created; ignored on an existing task_id.
